run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T02:17:05Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by real proxy-level error telemetry, but the proxy is the reporter, not the origin: frontend-proxy's own spans show 143.2 error spans on span 'ingress' and 94.45 on 'router frontend egress' in the 81-minute query window, and its Envoy access logs record 500/503/504 responses generated by the upstream frontend. Three distinct error mechanisms are visible. (1) A ~28-second burst of HTTP 500 'via_upstream' on POST/GET /api/cart and POST /api/checkout from 02:19:39.371Z to 02:20:07.343Z that coincides exactly with the cart Deployment rollout at 02:19:35-02:19:38Z (new ReplicaSet cart-84889c965d, old cart-755465879b deleted); the new cart pod only logged 'Successfully connected to Redis' at 02:19:51Z and was 90%+ CPU-throttled while starting. This burst is the largest error concentration (frontend 505.33 and frontend-proxy 252 error spans in one 1-minute bucket evaluated 02:21:00) but it starts ~2.5 minutes AFTER the alert's start time of 02:17:05Z, so it cannot be the initial trigger. (2) A burst of proxy 504 'UT response_timeout' (15,000-15,002 ms) on GET /api/data at 01:57:18-01:57:41Z, which traces explain as frontend /api/data taking 12.2-28.2s because ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds took 8.0-21.7s while ad's flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean calls failed with rpc.grpc.status_code=4 (DEADLINE_EXCEEDED). (3) A steady stream of 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses about once every 1-2 minutes from 01:58 onward (including 02:15:52Z and 02:17:52Z, immediately around the alert start), i.e. the frontend terminating connections before responding; the reason is not visible because the frontend container produced no log lines in the window. The alert's exact numeric basis could not be reproduced: at 02:17:05Z the trace-derived error ratio for frontend-proxy evaluates to 0 for both the all-span and ingress-only 5m variants, and the RequestErrorRate rule is not exposed by this Prometheus, so the reported 0.0111 and its evaluation window remain unverified. Separately, frontend pod CPU throttling was persistently 0.33-0.44 of CFS periods throughout 01:54-02:35 (no pre-window baseline available), and fraud-detection was OOMKilled and restarted at 02:25:05/02:25:06 with no evidence tying it to this alert.

claims.text: frontend-proxy emitted error-status spans in the 81-minute window: increase over 4866s = 143.203125 error spans on span_name 'ingress' and 94.453125 on 'router frontend egress', against 22,299.88 and 22,352.89 STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans (span counts of every operation, not request counts).

The frontend service records its own ERROR spans in the same window, e.g. span 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart' 76.23, 'POST' 71.13, 'POST /api/cart' 52.85, 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem' 52.85, 'GET /api/cart' 23.38, 'GET' 23.37, 'POST /api/checkout' 18.29, 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 18.30; cart, checkout and payment show 0 error spans.

The error spans concentrate in one burst: in a 1-minute bucket evaluated at 02:21:00 frontend had 505.33 error spans and frontend-proxy 252 (186 'ingress' + 186 'router frontend egress'); other 1-minute buckets from 01:59 to 02:31 hold 0-6 frontend-proxy error spans.

frontend-proxy access logs show HTTP 500 responses with response flag 'via_upstream' for 'POST /api/cart', 'GET /api/cart' and 'POST /api/checkout' between 02:19:39.371559Z and 02:20:07.343034Z, 99 matching lines in the read window, each with a 21-byte upstream body.

The cart Deployment was rolled out at 02:19:35-02:19:38Z: new ReplicaSet cart-84889c965d created 02:19:35Z (desired 1) while cart-755465879b was scaled to 0; events show 'ScalingReplicaSet cart Scaled up replica set cart-84889c965d from 0 to 1', 'Scaled down replica set cart-755465879b from 1 to 0', 'SuccessfulDelete' and 'Killing ... Stopping container cart'; both ReplicaSets use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart.

The replacement cart pod cart-84889c965d-tkxdz started its cart container at 02:19:37Z and logged 'Successfully connected to Redis' only at 02:19:51.610912Z; its container CPU throttling ratio was 0.938 (5m window ending 02:21:00) and 0.906 (ending 02:23:00).

frontend-proxy logs at 01:57:18.659Z-01:57:41.245Z show 504 responses with flag 'UT response_timeout' and upstream durations of 15,000-15,002 ms on 'GET /api/data' and 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=...' (26 matching 5xx lines in the 01:55-02:02 window).

Traces at 01:57:28-01:57:59Z show frontend 'GET /api/data' spans of 12.223s, 20.096s and 28.165s; frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 8.00s, 21.40s and 28.07s; ad 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 8.00s, 21.40s and 21.70s; ad 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean' client spans error=true with rpc.grpc.status_code=4 at 2.297-3.299s; load-generator 'GET' spans error=true http.status_code=504 at 15.0s; frontend-proxy 'ingress' spans error=true http.status_code=504 at 15.001s with matching 'router frontend egress' spans error=true http.status_code=0.

From 01:58 through 02:26 frontend-proxy logs a recurring 503 with flag 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' roughly every 1-2 minutes: 01:58:07, 01:59:03 (x2), 01:59:19, 02:00:35 (x2), 02:02:39, 02:03:42, 02:04:55, 02:06:09 (x2), 02:08:00, 02:08:12, 02:15:52, 02:17:52, 02:20:52 (x3), 02:21:58, 02:24:11, 02:26:40, on /api/products/*, /api/recommendations, /api/data and /api/cart, each with a 95-byte response and 200-893 ms duration.

frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-64mj8 and frontend-proxy pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-v4lvt are both Running with container ready=true and restartCount 0; the frontend container started 01:48:27Z and the frontend-proxy container 01:48:30Z (pod created 01:48:27Z).

Container CPU throttling for the frontend pod was 0.32-0.44 of CFS periods in every 5-minute window from 01:54 to 02:35 (e.g. 0.3491 at 02:20:00, 0.4393 at 02:35:00), while frontend-proxy stayed at 0.06-0.12 (0.0860 at 02:20:00); no pre-window baseline is available in this data.

Evaluated at the alert start time 02:17:05Z, the frontend-proxy error ratio derived from traces_span_metrics_calls_total is 0 with a 5-minute window, both for all spans and for span_name='ingress' only.

fraud-detection container was OOMKilled (terminated reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 02:25:05Z) with restartCount 1 and restarted at 02:25:06Z, matching pod events 'Created container: fraud-detection' and 'Started container: fraud-detection' at 02:25:06Z.

The flagd Deployment also changed in the window: ReplicaSet flagd-77f6d5b95d was created 01:50:20Z (desired 1) replacing flagd-c47676d99 (desired 0), both with images ghcr.io/open-feature/flagd:v0.12.8 and ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-flagd-ui.
ad recorded 1.333 error spans per 2-minute bucket only in the buckets covering ~02:14-02:16 and ~02:24-02:26; all other 2-minute buckets of 02:00-02:32 have 0 ad error spans.

The only request-related metric families present in this Prometheus are traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket (63 metric names returned, no http_*, envoy_* or rpc_client_* series in the window); the job label values are only kube-state-metrics, kubelet and otel-collector.

The 02:19:39-02:20:07Z burst of frontend 500s (and the 252 frontend-proxy error spans in the 02:21:00 minute bucket) was caused by the cart Deployment rollout: the old cart pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 was deleted at 02:19:38Z, the replacement pod's cart container started at 02:19:37Z but only established its Redis connection at 02:19:51Z while being ~94% CPU-throttled, so frontend calls to CartService failed and the frontend returned 500 for /api/cart and /api/checkout; this burst is after the alert start and cannot be its initial trigger.

The 01:56-01:57Z 504 burst at frontend-proxy was caused by ad-service slowness: frontend /api/data waited 12-28s on grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (8-21.7s), whose flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean calls failed with rpc.grpc.status_code=4 (DEADLINE_EXCEEDED) after 2.3-3.3s, pushing the request past the proxy's 15s route timeout; this may relate to the flagd Deployment replacement at 01:50:20Z, though flagd's own server-side ResolveBoolean spans returned in 2-157 ms, so the flagd side itself is not shown to be slow.

The steady 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses are generated by the frontend closing proxied requests before a response starts (status flag UC means upstream termination, not a proxy-side failure); the reason inside the frontend is not established, since the frontend container produced no log lines in the window; this steady error source, present at 02:15:52Z and 02:17:52Z, is the most plausible signal behind an alert that started at 02:17:05Z.

Persistent frontend container CPU throttling (0.33-0.44 of CFS periods) may contribute to frontend slow responses and connection terminations, but with no pre-window baseline and no frontend error logs this remains unproven and is not established as the cause.

frontend-proxy itself being crashed, restarted or resource-saturated is rejected as the origin of the errors: its container has restartCount 0, has been running since 01:48:30Z, and its CPU throttling ratio is only 0.06-0.12, while the 5xx responses it logged are upstream-generated (500 via_upstream, 503 UC, 504 UT).

The fraud-detection OOMKill is rejected as the cause of this alert: it happened at 02:25:05Z, eight minutes after the alert started at 02:17:05Z, and no frontend-proxy error burst is tied to it (only a single 1.33 ad error span in the 02:24-02:26 bucket).

The alert's reported current value (0.011111) is not reproduced from the available request telemetry at its own start instant: the frontend-proxy error ratio at 02:17:05Z is 0 for the 5m all-span and ingress-only variants, so either a different metric/window or a delayed data view underlies the alert.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not exposed: list_prometheus_rules returned no data both with rule_name filter and unfiltered (evidence 64332436-4ac4-868e-3280f49063ec-t0 and ce161de8-3623-4ea0-81c3-cf732c7a333e-t0), so the rule expression, its evaluation window, threshold and source metric are unknown and the reported 0.011111 could not be reproduced.

No request metric other than the trace-derived traces_span_metrics_calls_total/_bucket exists in this Prometheus (no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count, Envoy, or rpc_client_* series returned), so the metric the alert evaluates is unverified.

Jaeger holds no traces after about 02:05:31Z: traces_search for 02:10-02:38 and for 02:18-02:38 returned no data (evidence 285fae68-4f29-4147-bfa5-1167d9502463-t0 and 285fae68-4f29-4147-bfa5-1167d9502463-t1), so span-level detail for the alert period and the cart-rollout burst is unavailable.

The frontend container produced no log lines in 01:50-02:38 (evidence 79b41540-6ad7-4780-a204-7b12d25f7838-t1 and a89d4f0c-9547-4629-bd96-d6237911a817-t1), so the application-level reason for the frontend 500 responses and for the 503 UC connection terminations could not be read.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_available had no series in the window (evidence b03b6549-c11a-47c1-bc34-d05903c60ed8-t2), so Deployment availability/replica counts could not be verified through kube-state-metrics.

Kubernetes events returned only 16 events with timestamps 02:19:35Z-02:25:06Z (evidence ce161de8-3623-4ea0-81c3-cf732c7a333e-t2); events for the 01:48 cluster-wide pod creation and the 01:50:20Z flagd rollout were not available, so those changes cannot be fully characterized.

No baseline exists before 01:54 for CPU throttling or request latency in this data, so it cannot be stated whether frontend CPU throttling (0.33-0.44) or the ad/flagd latency burst is abnormal relative to a healthy period.

The cart Deployment rollout's trigger (configuration change vs image change) cannot be verified: both ReplicaSets carry the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart, and pod/deployment configuration details of the change (for example ConfigMap contents) are not readable.
next_steps: Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition (Prometheus rule file / Alertmanager config) to identify the exact PromQL, evaluation window and source metric behind the 0.011111 value.
Capture frontend application logs (currently silent) so the 500 responses and UC connection terminations can be attributed to specific application errors.
Make cart rollouts non-disruptive: add a readiness gate / preStop and minReadySeconds to the cart Deployment and raise its CPU limit so a replacement pod is not 90%+ throttled while warming up.

Investigate ad-service flagd evaluation: reproduce the rpc.grpc.status_code=4 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED ResolveBoolean calls, check ad's flagd connection/backoff behaviour after the flagd ReplicaSet replacement at 01:50:20Z, and evaluate whether the ad service's CPU/latency can exceed the proxy's 15s route timeout.
Review frontend CPU limits versus the load generator, since the frontend container was throttled for a third or more of CFS periods throughout the observed window.
